description: Frozen human-authored input used to build the memory-assertion/v1 conformance fixture.

ontology.definition: A closed example ontology for memory-assertion/v1 conformance tests.

entity.definition: A thing that can be identified in the assertion environment.

proposition.definition: The semantic type of a closed assertion reference.

quantity.definition: A canonical mass quantity expressed in kilograms for this conformance Snapshot.

datetime.definition: A canonical UTC ISO 8601 date-time ending in Z.

duration.definition: A canonical non-negative duration normalized to ISO 8601 seconds form.

money.definition: A canonical monetary amount governed by the embedded currency minor-unit table.

created_by.definition: Tests whether a model was created by an organization.

possible.definition: Tests whether the referenced proposition is presented as possible.

event_time.definition: Tests whether the referenced proposition has the explicitly stated event date.

believes.definition: Tests whether a person is explicitly presented as believing a proposition.
